items.title: Blog The UK’s Healthy Life Expectancy Challenge - How can Independent Healthcare Help? 11/08/2026 Healthy life expectancy in the UK has stalled, leaving millions of people living more years in poor health. In this blog, we explore the reasons behind the decline and the four key ways the independent sector can help improve outcomes, reduce inequalities, and deliver timely, high-quality care. Read more
items.label: IHPN

items.title: Blog The Missing Picture: Why NHS Data Underestimates the Independent Sector's Role in Diagnostics 06/08/2026 The latest NHS Diagnostic Imaging Dataset provides an important snapshot of imaging activity, but it doesn't tell the whole story. Our latest analysis reveals independent sector diagnostics providers delivered around 4 million NHS scans in 2025/26 (over 2.3 million more than official data report) and explores why greater transparency is needed to support future NHS planning. Read more
items.label: IHPN

items.title: Blog Could workplace healthcare schemes become part of the answer to getting Britain working again? 28/07/2026 Could workplace healthcare schemes help tackle economic inactivity? As employers play a greater role in supporting workforce health, workplace healthcare is becoming more than just an employee benefit. This blog explores how employer-funded healthcare, mutual schemes and partnerships with independent healthcare providers could help people stay in work, return to work sooner and reduce pressure on the NHS. Read more
